turns.doctor: Hi, come in, take any seat you like. I'm one of the doctors. How can I help today?
How long has this been going on, and did anything change around the time it started?
Tell me a bit about work. How are things there?
That sounds like a lot of pressure. How has your mood been through all this?
What do you normally do to relax, and are you still doing it?
Do you drink alcohol, or use anything else to cope?
Could you look at the light for me, please?
It sounds like you've been carrying this on your own. Some people in your position have thoughts of ending their life, or wish they wouldn't wake up. Has anything like that happened for you?
Have you made any plans, or do you have tablets or anything at home you might use?
Who would you turn to if things got worse?
I'm asking because I care about how safe you are. Even fleeting thoughts, like wishing you wouldn't wake up in the morning?
Thank you for trusting me with this. Let's work out a plan together, starting with some support for your sleep and mood.
